citation_evidence: Sussex County probate index card, Estate of Eli Norwood. Date Jan. 2, 1838; probated May 23, 1838. Archives Volume A91, pages 113-114, Register of Wills. Administratrix: Elon Norwood. Heirs per the card's note (Arch. Vol. A91, p. 114): widow Elon Norwood and 7 children, Eli, Stephen D., William D., Wingate P., Samuel B., Mary Jane Whittington, and Ann Johnson; and issue of son John (Charles and Benjamin Norwood). Cross-reference: Elon Norwood also appears as a buyer at the 1836 estate sale of Whittington Clark (Delaware Public Archives 4545-000-009). Card image filed in the archive media as norwood_eli_probate_card_1838.png and in Drive, Genealogy Records.
correction_2026_11_26: Pre-run audit by Orbit against the live schema and the exporter (the Package 4 lesson). The photo object now carries the full unified_photo_catalog row spec with the archive's document-row conventions (546 existing document rows read from photos.json): subtype historical_document, face_context none, routing_target documents, confidence 1.0, surname/given_names, normalized_filename, primary person link fields, dates_mentioned, and the card contents as transcription. The original file set only 9 fields and left the rest to a template-row copy in the script; that copy was nondeterministic and has been removed. Source, citation evidence, person, and fact are unchanged.
